# Daylign
> A serene, lightweight personal learning, habit, and activity tracker with configurable reset cadences, timers, and analytics.

## About
Daylign is a calm productivity tool for tracking habits, daily activities, and time spent on tasks. It features:
- Configurable daily/permanent checklist reset modes
- Built-in stopwatch timer for task duration tracking
- 7-day and 30-day analytics visualization
- Sticky notes for quick thoughts and reminders
- Organized categories with pastel color themes
- Real-time sync across devices via Cloud Firestore

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript SPA with Firebase JS SDK v10
- Backend: Firebase Cloud Functions (Express REST API)
- Database: Cloud Firestore with offline persistence
- Auth: Firebase Authentication (Google, Email, Anonymous)
- Hosting: Firebase Hosting
